options.name: slides
options.description: Slides: { content: Node | string, label? } (1 to 100).

options.name: loop
options.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first and back.

options.name: autoplay
options.description: Rotation interval in milliseconds (at least 2000), or null.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the control labels and slide positions.

properties.name: rotating
properties.description: Whether automatic rotation is running now.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show a slide (no event); clamped, or wrapped with loop.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Stop rotation and remove rendering, attributes, and listeners.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user moved to another slide: { index }.

cssClasses.name: aui-carousel--autoplay | --animated
cssClasses.description: Autoplay configured; transitions enabled after the first move.

cssClasses.name: aui-carousel__viewport
cssClasses.description: Clips the track; the live region.

cssClasses.name: aui-carousel__slide | __slide--current
cssClasses.description: A slide (role=group, roledescription slide) and the current one.

cssClasses.name: aui-carousel__dot | __dot--current
cssClasses.description: A picker button and the current one.
